description: This file defines the Gauge interface, which represents a metric instrument for measuring instantaneous long values, allowing increment, decrement, setting, and retrieval of its current value.

classes.name: Gauge
classes.description: An interface for a gauge metric, supporting value manipulation and retrieval operations.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the gauge value by one and returns the gauge instance.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements the gauge value by one and returns the gauge instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the gauge to a specified Long value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the gauge.
